bayts.text: I turned my whole being toward a Generous One, and He reproved (me) with a reproof of honour, and I thought: “Splendid, splendid!”.
To You is my discourse, thankful, dating it: that is, the year “adornment of Your gratitude” (1307 AH / 1889-90), dated.
You have effaced from me ostentation and haughtiness, O Subduer Who tames whoever grows haughty.
You made me die (to myself) until I entered the Barzakh (the isthmus): so grant me a barrier against every evil.
O He Who softens every mountain that towers proudly, crushing it to dust: for me subdue every evildoer who has grown arrogant.
Hold back from me every oppressor who has boasted, by the sword of him who struck on the head whoever does not obey You,
by the sword of him who made brotherhood in You everlasting, and subdued those who opposed You.
You sheltered me with You through him, and he made (me) a master; by his rank, O best Guide, make (me) a master.
Subdue through him, for me, whoever has shown arrogance, and grant me (a gift) that shames a torrent that has swept (all) away.
By his rank humble my enemies for me, O You Who have gripped everyone who has been humbled.
You have spared me the gloom of what thickened of the nights, and I gave thanks exulting.
You have effaced from me harm and filth: so give glad tidings of me to every guide firmly rooted (in knowledge).
I am well pleased with You: so make ease endure for me, and grant me to be a youth succoured (at his cry).
I have sold what I stripped off, and it came away (from me); by Your noble Face subdue for me the obstinate deaf one.
I have made final the sale of goods whose contract has not been annulled, and shall never be annulled.
O Enricher, Who drove toward me an abundant gift, grant me separation from everyone who has grown proud.
You were for me on the sea, and I became a feast among the enemies: so turn toward me a feast (of joy).
Turn toward me that through which I may become one who strikes (the enemies) down, and subdue for me every cunning one swollen with pride.
Subject to me the trinitarian who has raised his nose high, led on by degrees (to ruin), and has grown proud.
Direct against him, among the armies, a mighty (blow), and crush the head of each with Your vengeance.
Hear the supplication of a wronged stranger who has cried out, and make him a youth succoured.
Punish with a lasting punishment, already sullied (with infamy), those whose religion is a religion debased tomorrow.
Answer, through him who never ceased to be a lion that humbles (the enemies), the supplication of a wronged servant who has been humbled.
Whoever comes to You, grant him (good) perpetually, and shatter his enemies, O best Just One Who shatters.
Bring into being, for him who drew the sword of sacred struggle, the best blessing with an abiding peace,
Muḥammad, he of whom I said “Splendid, splendid!”, and upon the Family and the Companions; and reprove my whole being.
